# Research report 1 of 2

Only material dated on or before 2026-10-15 is included below. I left out anything published later.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding source is anthropic.com/news. A model release there counts even if the model is not publicly accessible.
- 2026-10-15: I fetched the news page. Up to the cutoff, the newest model posts are Claude Haiku 5.5 (Oct 7), Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Sep 28), Claude Opus 5.5 (Sep 22) and "Claude Mythos and Fable 5.1" (dated Sep 15 on the page). Non-model posts include a Singapore office and MOU (Oct 14) and a post on giving METR evaluation access (Oct 15). As of Oct 15 there is no Fable 5.5 post. [Anthropic news](https://www.anthropic.com/news)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet. As of 2026-10-15 Anthropic has not announced Fable 5.5, and Fable 5.1 is still the latest Fable model. To resolve YES, Anthropic would have to post an announcement on Oct 15 or 16 (PST).

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-15: A leaker called "Lyra" posted that partners had access to the upcoming Fable model and predicted a release "the following week." That points to the week of about Oct 19, after this question's deadline. TestingCatalog wrote this up later. [TestingCatalog](https://www.testingcatalog.com/anthropic-several-models-coming-fable-5-5-reaches-partners/)
- 2026-10-13: A LiteLLM entry for `azure_ai/claude-fable-5-5` was added from Azure's East US 2 model list. Its price, context and deprecation fields were copied exactly from Fable 5.1, so they look like placeholders. One X screenshot showed the model labeled "Generally available" in Azure's catalog. This suggests preparation is under way but is not a launch. [daily.dev](https://daily.dev/posts/claude-fable-5-5-shows-up-in-azure-configs-as-polymarket-expects-an-october-release-f1hffcfsf), [pasqualepillitteri.it](https://pasqualepillitteri.it/en/news/20012/claude-fable-5-5-leak-beats-opus-5-5)
- Early/mid October 2026: The Information reportedly said a new Anthropic model was due "this month," without naming the model family. I could not open the original article. [cellcog](https://cellcog.ai/blog/fable-5-5-release-date/)
- 2026-10-02: A post claiming Fable 5.5 beats "GPT-6 Astra" spread online. This is unverified. [orcarouter](https://www.orcarouter.ai/fr/blog/claude-fable-5-5-polymarket)
- Commentators are speculating about an Anthropic IPO in November and a push for launch momentum before it. This is opinion only. [BridgeMind on X](https://x.com/bridgemindai/status/2105974336339202362)
- Some blogs run headlines saying "Fable 5.5 is here," but their own text admits there is no announcement. I would not rely on them. [Medium](https://medium.com/data-science-in-your-pocket/claude-fable-5-5-is-here-f6961e621590)

## 4. Base rates
- Fable line so far: Fable 5 came out on 2026-06-09. Fable 5.1 came out on Sep 1 according to secondary sources, but the Anthropic news page dates it Sep 15. That makes the gap between Fable releases about 12 to 14 weeks. [SD Times](https://sdtimes.com/tag/mythos-5-1/), [llmgateway](https://llmgateway.io/models/claude-fable-5-1)
- The 5.5 rollout for the other model tiers came about weekly: Opus 5.5 on Sep 22, Sonnet 5.5 on Sep 28, Haiku 5.5 on Oct 7. That is 8 days since the last model launch. A Fable 5.5 on Oct 15-16 would be only about 4.5 weeks after Fable 5.1, which is quicker than the earlier Fable gap.
- Model appearances in cloud catalogs and LiteLLM have historically come days to a couple of weeks before Anthropic launches. I could not find exact past lead times.
- For any particular two-day window, the base rate is low unless a launch-day signal shows up, such as an embargo, an event, or docs going live.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-10-07 snapshot: Polymarket has a series on "Fable 5.2 or higher released by…" (created Sep 3). The Oct 31 contract was about 91¢ and the Dec 31 contract about 97¢. [orcarouter](https://www.orcarouter.ai/fr/blog/claude-fable-5-5-polymarket)
- Another source reported roughly 94% for a release by Oct 31. [Fable 5.5 search coverage, daily.dev](https://daily.dev/posts/claude-fable-5-5-shows-up-in-azure-configs-as-polymarket-expects-an-october-release-f1hffcfsf)
- I could not find a market price for a deadline of Oct 16 or for this exact market.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The only window left is Oct 15-16 (through 11:59 PM PST Oct 16). I found no Anthropic event, livestream or embargo planned for those dates.
- Things to watch:
  - anthropic.com/news and the Anthropic models docs page
  - Azure, Bedrock and Vertex catalogs going live
  - Leaker posts (TestingCatalog, Lyra)
- The partner-access leak itself pointed to the following week, not Oct 16.

## 4. Base rates
- Anthropic shipped about one model a week from mid-September to early October:

  - Opus 5.5: Sep 22 (7 days later)
  - Sonnet 5.5: Sep 28 (6 days later)
  - Haiku 5.5: Oct 7 (9 days later)

- Fable 5.1 to a possible Fable 5.5 would be a gap of only about 1 to 1.5 months.
- In the past, models have appeared in cloud catalogs before launch, often days ahead. That has not always meant a launch within 1-3 days. I found no systematic data on the lag between an Azure listing and Anthropic's announcement.
- A 2-day window (Oct 15-16) is narrow. I found no source naming either date.

- 2026-10-07 snapshot of Polymarket's "Next Fable Model (5.2+) released by...?":

  - Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 are excluded, and any Fable model numbered 5.2 or higher counts. [orcarouter.ai](https://www.orcarouter.ai/sv/blog/claude-fable-5-5-polymarket)

- I could not find a Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold price for an Oct 16 deadline, and I could not find the Manifold market this question appears to come from.
